CONSTRUCTION ISSUE — subject to site survey & local engineer sign-off
Lattice bars 36x36, half-lapped, PU glued + SS pins
SS 316 insect mesh 1.0 mm (inside face, optional)
Thermally-broken aluminium single door, inward opening, slim 60 frame, bronze (RAL 8019 matt or bronze anodised). 6T/16Ar/6T
Multi-point lock, 3 hinges, 300 SS pull bar, euro cylinder, drop-seal, level
Insulated aluminium roller shutter, 77 mm double-skin PU-foamed slats, RAL 8019 matt, 80 side guides, 300 coil box concealed
Tubular motor 230 V + manual override, obstacle safety edge, 2 remotes, push-button
Timber lattice ventilated door, outward opening. Leaf 834 x 2357 x 54. Stiles 90, top rail 110, bottom rail 200. Lattice 6 x 18
openings 79 x 80, bars 36. Free vent area ≈ 0.68 m².
3 SS 102 hinges, lever lock (sashlock), SS kick plate inside, door stay; oiled
Thermo-ash lattice screen 45 x 38 bars @ ~120, posts 100x100 on HDG post shoes on 400x400x600 pads. Gate leaf 980 x 1680.
2 HD SS strap hinges, gravity latch both sides, drop bolt, gate stop

Joinery notes: all external joinery sizes to be confirmed by site measure after openings are made good. Timber joinery factory-finished all 6 faces (oil), MC 12–15 %. Aluminium systems to EN 14351-1; installation to manufacturer's details with EPDM membranes to reveals,
low-expansion PU foam & external silicone (colour matched). D02 coil box requires 300 x 300 clear zone inside head — check interior.
